edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the `from` address of the core transfer logic.
msg.sender is the sender of transfer().
msg.sender becomes the spender in transferFrom and can be re-approved.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve().
onlyOwner on setTrading: caller identity gates enabling trading.
onlyOwner on blockBots allows the owner to freeze arbitrary accounts.
onlyOwner can raise buy/sell taxes up to 99%, a privileged rug vector.
onlyOwner can exempt arbitrary accounts from fees.
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline, a miner-manipulable value.
uniswapV2Router is used to build the swap path and execute the swap.
uniswapV2Pair is compared with from/to to classify buys and sells.
_marketingAddress is the destination of all ETH fees.
tradingOpen gating forces non-owner transfers to revert before trading is enabled.
_isExcludedFromFee decides takeFee and whether the contract swap runs.
_maxTxAmount caps transfers and also caps the swap amount.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap block.
inSwap blocks a nested swap while the router call is running.
lockTheSwap sets inSwap around the router call.
Buy/sell reflection fee is written into _redisFee before _tokenTransfer.
Buy/sell tax fee is written into _taxFee before _tokenTransfer.
_rTotal = _rTotal.sub(rFee) mutates the reflection supply; a rounding/underflow reverts transfers.
_tFeeTotal accumulates tFee; unbounded growth in reflection accounting.
Allowance is read and decreased in transferFrom.
_tTotal is used to derive tSupply for the reflection rate.
_getRate divides rSupply by tSupply; truncation to zero breaks reflection accounting.
tFee = tAmount.mul(redisFee).div(100) loses precision and can round fees down to zero.
tTeam = tAmount.mul(taxFee).div(100) loses precision on small transfers.
setMaxTxnAmount compares against a hardcoded 5e21 threshold before writing.
Constructor calls the external factory createPair.
Constructor calls _msgSender() to mint the initial supply.
Constructor calls owner() to set fee exemptions.
Constructor assigns the created pair to uniswapV2Pair.
Constructor assigns the router to uniswapV2Router.
balanceOf converts reflection balance with tokenFromReflection.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when the swap conditions hold.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance after the swap.
_transfer calls balanceOf for wallet-size and contract-balance checks.
swapTokensForEth approves the router to spend the contract tokens.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH out to the marketing address.
_tokenTransfer removes fees when takeFee is false.
_tokenTransfer restores fees when takeFee is false.
_takeTeam calls _getRate to convert tTeam into rTeam.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract token balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
ETH is pushed to _marketingAddress after lockTheSwap has been released, so a malicious/compromised receiver can re-enter _transfer and repeat the fee extraction while inSwap is false.

The router swap pulls tokens from this contract via transferFrom, re-entering _transfer during the external call; the inSwap flag mitigates nested swaps but fee and reflection state are still recomputed.
